verdict.rationale: The docs say vLLM supports 200+ Hugging Face model architectures. It also offers a Transformers modeling backend and trust_remote_code loading for further models, and a community user praises its 'huge model library'. MoE support is shown by multi-LoRA for MoE layers and expert parallelism. Multimodal support is only hinted at by disaggregated 'encode', and embedding models are never mentioned. missing for 10: explicit documentation of multimodal model support, any evidence of embedding/pooling model support, independent corroboration of the breadth of architectures.
